# MailFn

> Programmable inboxes, MIME evidence, scoped access, testing, and agent workflows.

## Documentation

- [Administration capability](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mailfn/docs/content/docs/administration.md) — Understand MailFn's Super Console resource and action contract.
- [CLI and MCP](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mailfn/docs/content/docs/cli-and-mcp.md) — Operate inboxes with sanitized CLI output and narrow agent tools.
- [Cloudflare runtime](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mailfn/docs/content/docs/cloudflare-runtime.md) — Provision Email Routing, D1, R2, Queues, and Worker handlers.
- [Core and storage](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mailfn/docs/content/docs/core-and-storage.md) — Embed the provider-neutral service and supply durable adapters.
- [Credentials and scope](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mailfn/docs/content/docs/credentials-and-scope.md) — Use one-time inbox credentials and narrow API permissions.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mailfn/docs/content/docs/getting-started.md) — Create a scoped inbox, wait for mail, and extract a verification value.
- [MailFn](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mailfn/docs/content/docs/index.md) — Programmable inboxes with durable MIME evidence and scoped APIs.
- [Messages and evidence](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mailfn/docs/content/docs/messages-and-evidence.md) — Understand raw MIME, normalized messages, attachments, and retention.
- [Operations and limits](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mailfn/docs/content/docs/operations-and-limits.md) — Release gate, retention, production flags, and live-service proof.
- [Outbound through SendFn](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mailfn/docs/content/docs/outbound.md) — Compose drafts, replies, and forwards with a delivery adapter.

- [@mailfn/client](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mailfn/docs/content/docs/reference/client.md) — Source package guide for MailFn client.
- [@mailfn/cloudflare](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mailfn/docs/content/docs/reference/cloudflare.md) — Source package guide for MailFn cloudflare.
- [Consumer fixtures](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mailfn/docs/content/docs/reference/consumers.md) — Typechecked integration shapes used by the release gate.
- [@mailfn/core](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mailfn/docs/content/docs/reference/core.md) — Source package guide for MailFn core.
- [mailfn facade](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mailfn/docs/content/docs/reference/facade.md) — Source package guide for MailFn facade.
